scripts.test:bootstrap: npm run build && playwright test tests/workspace/bootstrap.test.ts
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build && playwright test tests/workspace

spielwerk.setup: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium
spielwerk.development: npm run dev; open the printed local URL.
spielwerk.staticHosting: npm run build; serve or publish dist/ using any static HTTP host, including a subdirectory. npm run preview serves dist/ locally. No backend or file:// support is required.

testContracts.test:bootstrap: Build and run Chromium mount/asset smoke tests against Vite development and plain static HTTP hosting (Python 3 required).
testContracts.test:workspace: Build and run tests/workspace; later foundation tasks add focused tests here.
testContracts.test:integration: Reserved for tests/integration, supplied by final integration. Fails with no tests until that task lands; not a bootstrap acceptance gate.
